title: Anti-Carved Pumpkin
description: This is a resource pack that removes the carved pumpkin overlay. It should work on all versions, including future ones.
body:
This is a resource pack for all versions of Minecraft.

What it does: It removes the Carved Pumpkin overlay.

Why should I use it: It makes dealing with Endermen a lot easier, since looking at them won't anger them if you have a Carved Pumpkin on. Also, if you ever get a Curse of Binding Carved Pumpkin stuck on your head in a hardcore world, you can use this pack and basically forget that it's there!

Warning: This pack has NOT been tested on versions besides 1.21.11! It'll likely work on all versions, but be warned. Don't worry, it can't harm your computer, your account, your world, anything, even if the pack doesn't work on that version.

Also, if a certain version does not work with this pack (which is highly unlikely), please let me know! I will most likely read your comment and get it fixed! (Nobody will comment anyway, since this pack will get like 3 downloads)

How to use: (You likely already know, but this is for the people that don't)

1. Open Minecraft
2. Click on Options
3. Click on Resource Packs
4. Click on Open Pack Folder
5. Download the Pack (duh)
6. Copy the pack file over to the Explorer window Minecraft opened for you
7. In-game, enable the pack named "Anti Carved Pumpkin"
8. Click on Done
